# Vendor directory

## OpenDataLoader PDF

Toolman can use [donatomm/open-data-loader-pdf](https://github.com/donatomm/open-data-loader-pdf) from `open-data-loader-pdf/` (created by `pnpm vendor:odl`).

```bash
pnpm vendor:odl
pnpm install
```

See [docs/engineering/OPENDATALOADER_PDF.md](../docs/engineering/OPENDATALOADER_PDF.md).
